name: Custom Product Configurator for WooCommerce
author: zechkonja

sections.description:
Turn any WooCommerce store into a visual configurator storefront — no code, intuitive UI, and best-in-class performance.
Perfect for store owners selling customizable products like furniture, shoes, print-on-demand items, and more.

Who Is This Plugin For:
– WooCommerce merchants selling customizable products
– Stores that need live previews without hundreds of variations
– Developers building bespoke product flows
– Stores requiring layered image previews and extensible architecture

Real-World Example Use Cases

This plugin is built for real WooCommerce stores that sell customizable products, such as:

  • Furniture products – choose material, color, legs, or accessories with live preview
  • Doors & windows – panel types, glass options, handles, and add-ons
  • Print-on-demand products – layered designs, colors, and visual combinations
  • Custom items – any product that requires visual selection instead of many variations

Each example demonstrates real product setups with live previews and pricing logic.

👉 See live demos and real usage examples

Key Features

  • Visual product configuration using layered images
  • Create unlimited configuration views and options
  • Works directly on WooCommerce product pages
  • Separate admin and frontend React apps for smooth experience
  • Extendable and developer-friendly architecture

Premium features:
– Conditional rules between options
– Category-based configurations
– Price add-ons per option
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/product-configurator, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your settings under WooCommerce → Product Configurator.
  4. Create a new configuration and assign it to a product.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, you can use it with simple or variable WooCommerce products.

Can I add extra price for certain options?

Yes — this is a part of the premium version.

Can I customize the colors and styling?

Yes. The configurator uses clean CSS classes and CSS variables.
You can override styles using your theme’s Custom CSS or a child theme.

To customize styling, add custom CSS via Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS.

Example:

.custprco-field {
  background: #f97316;
}
